summary_en: ¥47/share (¥35 ordinary + ¥12 special); ¥511M total; full-year dividend ¥102/share (¥90 prior guidance + ¥12 increase); target consolidated DOE ~10%; record date 2026-06-30; effective 2026-09-11.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Surplus Distribution (Year-End and Special Dividends)
translation_en_brief: KOZO KEIKAKU ENGINEERING HOLDINGS resolved on 2026-08-10 to pay a year-end dividend of ¥47 per share, comprising ¥35 in ordinary dividend and ¥12 in special dividend, totalling ¥511M. The record date is 2026-06-30 and the effective date is 2026-09-11. Full-year dividend per share reaches ¥102 (first quarter ¥15, second quarter ¥20, third quarter ¥20, fourth quarter ¥47), representing a ¥12 increase versus the ¥90 guidance issued on 2025-08-12. The company's basic dividend policy emphasizes continuous and stable payouts to shareholders while maintaining internal reserves for business development and operational strengthening, targeting consolidated DOE (dividend on equity) at approximately 10%.
